en.baseline: Not proxied by this plugin: original dispatcher restored (not necessarily direct)
en.description: Routes DSH in-process outbound requests (child processes via exported env); loopback (localhost/127.0.0.1) stays direct by default. Saves apply immediately, no restart; the profile cordis.patch.yml remains editable
en.failed: Save failed; settings may have changed elsewhere. Choose again to retry
en.invalid: Enter a valid HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy URL
en.manualMissing: Manual proxy has no valid URL
en.quickSettings: Edit URL and bypass rules: Settings → General → Network proxy
en.routeCaveat: Read-only snapshot, not a health check. NO_PROXY/loopback rules may bypass individual requests. A saved revision may not yet be applied on the host; refresh to check.
en.systemUnknown: Follow system; see DSH logs for the effective route
en.title: Network proxy
